summary: Frontend-only verification of the two bug fixes on Home hero (crisp image + glass-morphism text panel) and Residences gallery (elderlyDancing photo removed). Both fixes verified working. No regressions detected.
critical_code_review_comments: Home.jsx: Clean implementation — glass-morphism panel isolates blur to the text container only, keeping the hero image sharp. Left-only gradient (from-[#0C2415]/60 via-[#0C2415]/15 to-transparent) is well-tuned.
Residences.jsx: photos[] array cleanly reduced to 3 entries; the conditional fit/bg logic was properly stripped from the render (simple object-cover + p.pos). No orphan letterbox styles remain.
Minor code quality (non-blocking): Residences gallery uses key={i} in map — safe here since photos array is static, but keying on p.src would be more idiomatic.
